data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims reserves opened the year at GBP 389.009m. Analysis of the claims development triangle shows a net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 71.205m (c.18.3% of opening reserves), driven largely by a very active 2020 Atlantic hurricane season and significant wildfires in the USA, together with large individual risk losses particularly within casualty/third-party liability and political risk exposures. COVID-19 exposure was limited with specific reserves held net of reinsurance.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) gross figure derived from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) by comparing current estimates to the prior diagonal for UW years 2016-2018. No explicit single-line gross 'movement in prior year's provision' note was found. Exact textual statement quantifying gross PYD was not present, so triangle method was used (confidence 0.8). The report notes RITC and year-of-account reinsurance activity (2018 RITC into 2019; intentions to RITC 2019/2020 into syndicate 3500) which can distort development tables; this may affect the triangle calculation. Some quantified amounts in the narrative are stated net of reinsurance (e.g. $36,800k wildfires net; GBP 15,600k COVID net) - no corresponding gross figures were disclosed.
